file: 404 You Can Still Play the OLD Arsenal on Roblox.mp4

lines.t: You can still play the old version of Arsenal on Roblox.

full.credit: Clips: RBXJuno; Mystery Monk (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Arsenal came out on August 18th, 2015. Get a kill, and your gun changes. First to the golden knife wins.

full.credit: Clips: RBXJuno; Mystery Monk (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: In November 2018, a mega update changed almost everything. So ROLVe kept the old one as Arsenal Archived.

full.credit: Clips: RBXJuno; Mystery Monk (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: The main game now has over 6 billion visits.
